verdict.rationale: The evidence shows building blocks rather than a documented split-inbox feature. There are automation rules (up to 1000), labels you can search within, shared team inboxes and tailored team spaces, plus an optional agent that triages new conversations before you see them. Nothing shows the inbox being divided into priority streams such as important, newsletters or calendar invites, so the story is only implied through rule- and label-based workarounds. Missing for 10: a documented split-inbox or focused-streams view, built-in categories for newsletters, calendar invites or important mail, priority-ordered triage across streams, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
